body.name: Covariance-eliminated observable cubics
body.construction: Set \(v=\Sigma_{22}\), \(p=\Sigma_{12}\), \(q=\Sigma_{23}\), \(r=\Sigma_{13}\), \(\chi=vr-pq\), \(l(z)=vz-p\), and \(t(z)=qz-r\). Define the polynomial cancellations \(P_3(z)=l(z)F_{21}(z,t(z)/l(z))\) and \(Q_3(z)=l(z)^2F_{12}(z,t(z)/l(z))\).
